title: Sheaf.H acyclicity of an injective ModuleCat-valued sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring, and let $J$ be an injective object of the category of ModuleCat-valued sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Its underlying abelian sheaf $J_{ab}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] has $H^q(X,J_{ab})=0$ for $q>0$, where cohomology is Sheaf.H [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No torsion assumption, affine hypothesis, or closed immersion occurs. In Lean the coefficient ring may have universe u+1 while X has universe u.

source.place: Lemma cohomology-modules-abelian-agree, second paragraph of proof, applied to the terminal object of the small etale site

proof.text: Use moduleSheaf_constantRing_equivalence to obtain an equivalence to modules over the constant ring sheaf R of Lambda. Set I=e.functor.obj J; equivalences preserve injective objects. Its underlying abelian sheaf G is naturally isomorphic to the underlying abelian sheaf of J.

Transfer injectivity of the sheaf of modules to its underlying module presheaf using injective_module_sheaf_injective_presheaf. At p=q+1 apply injective_presheaf_module_cech_cocycle_lift_max with hom universe u and coefficient/index universe u+1. CochainComplex.of_d identifies the differentials with differentialValue; ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff and ExactAt.isZero_homology give zero SiteCechComplex cohomology. The original etale comparison and remaining conclusion then follow unchanged. This replaces the invalid common-universe ringed-site acyclicity invocation.

Apply isZero_rightDerived_etale_of_cech_vanishing with all objects and all coverings, each cover refining itself by identity maps. It gives zero positive right-derived abelian evaluation of G at the terminal etale object T=Etale.mk(identity X).

Mathlib Sheaf.GammaNatIsoSheafSections identifies global sections with evaluation at T. Apply NatTrans.rightDerived to its hom and inverse; rightDerived_comp and rightDerived_id show these maps are inverse. Transport the zero evaluation group to the right-derived global sections group. Use homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso (the unbounded compatibility of the bounded-below single identification) and nonempty_sheafH_extDerivedIso to transport zero to Sheaf.functorH(G,q). Finally map the underlying abelian sheaf isomorphism through Sheaf.functorH and use AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero.

proof_origin.place: Existing source argument, with V2 forced replacement of ringed-site acyclicity by presheaf cocycle lifting in universe u+1; no signature changes.
